coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Apply the <slug>.jobs.cz / kariera.<domain> pointer heuristic against the full ČNB list of licensed banks and payment institutions, and add each discovered portal.

coverage_gaps.description: Job ads expire and are removed; no archival strategy identified, so historical hiring-burst baselines cannot be reconstructed retroactively.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Start snapshotting listing indices immediately to build a forward baseline, and test Wayback Machine coverage of jobs.cz bank subdomains for partial backfill.

brief: CZ vacancy intelligence is unusually concentrated: LMC's Jobs.cz ecosystem is both the dominant board and the white-label host for most large banks' own career sites (kb., csob., rb., moneta., unicreditbank.jobs.cz), so one enumeration pattern yields near-complete official coverage of the incumbents. Around it sit StartupJobs.cz and ATS-hosted fintech boards (Twisto on Recruitee) whose ad text discloses tech stack and compliance posture in detail, Prace.cz for branch-network staffing, and the Úřad práce statutory vacancy register as the only officially-mandated feed. The richest leadership signal — LinkedIn Jobs and Glassdoor reviews — is auth-walled and ToS-restricted, so that half of the cell must be budgeted as manual analyst review rather than automated collection. The core methodological point is that no single ad is evidence: value comes from repeated diffing of listing indices over time, which means snapshotting must begin now to establish a baseline.
